hooks.name: hopper_pickup_item
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no direct equivalent; Bukkit's InventoryPickupItemEvent)

rust_summary: A hopper is about to pick up a dropped item (`native_hopper_pickup_item`).
doc_summary: A hopper is about to pick up a dropped stack: `native_hopper_pickup_item(dimension, pos, item, count, cancel)` names its position and stack. Set `cancel` to leave the item in the world. Bundles need "hooks": @API:hopper_pickup_item@.
